items.current_problem: Prompt production masih dapat tersebar sebagai string panjang tanpa version, status, dan rollback.
items.upgrade_objective: Membuat seluruh prompt reusable, versioned, testable, dan dapat diaudit.
items.implementation_recommendation: Simpan prompt_id, version, task_type, model compatibility, edition, input schema, output schema, examples, constraints, safety, benchmark, status, dan rollback target.
items.expected_behavior: Setiap prompt production memiliki identitas, kontrak, version, dan benchmark.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tidak ada prompt production anonim atau unversioned.
items.guardrail_notes: System prompt tidak boleh berubah otomatis tanpa approval.

items.current_problem: Prompt yang dipakai ulang belum memiliki parameter dan output contract yang konsisten.
items.upgrade_objective: Mengubah prompt menjadi komponen seperti fungsi.
items.implementation_recommendation: Tentukan name, purpose, required inputs, optional inputs, defaults, constraints, output schema, failure mode, dan tests.
items.expected_behavior: Prompt dapat dipanggil ulang tanpa copy-paste dan input invalid ditolak.
items.acceptance_criteria: Seluruh prompt reusable lulus schema validation.
items.guardrail_notes: Parameter user tidak boleh menjadi system instruction.

items.current_problem: Perubahan prompt dapat menurunkan kualitas tanpa jalur pemulihan.
items.upgrade_objective: Mengontrol seluruh lifecycle prompt.
items.implementation_recommendation: Gunakan DRAFT, CANDIDATE, BENCHMARKED, APPROVED, CANARY, ACTIVE, ROLLED_BACK, REJECTED, dan DEPRECATED.
items.target_files_or_modules: prompt registry; release manifest; rollback service
items.expected_behavior: Prompt buruk dapat dihentikan dan versi sebelumnya dipulihkan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Canary failure otomatis memblokir full activation dan rollback berhasil.

items.current_problem: Prompt, tool format, dan structured output dapat digunakan sama untuk semua model.
items.upgrade_objective: Menyesuaikan NusaMind dengan model Qwen lokal yang benar-benar aktif.
items.implementation_recommendation: Simpan model version, chat template, function calling format, stop tokens, context profile, thinking support, temperature, top_p, quantization, RAM/VRAM, benchmark, dan failure cases.
items.expected_behavior: Prompt compiler dan agent memakai template sesuai model Qwen aktif.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tool calling dan structured-output tests lulus per model version.
items.guardrail_notes: Prompt optimal untuk model lain tidak otomatis diterapkan ke Qwen.

items.current_problem: Kemampuan model dapat diasumsikan berdasarkan nama atau ukuran model.
items.upgrade_objective: Mengukur kemampuan model lokal secara nyata.
items.implementation_recommendation: Benchmark instruction following, JSON, tools, long context, reasoning, multilingual, safety, hallucination, latency, RAM, dan quantization.
items.expected_behavior: Router memilih strategy dan context budget berdasarkan profile aktual.
items.acceptance_criteria: Setiap model ACTIVE memiliki profile, version, checksum, dan test date.

items.current_problem: Identity, safety, edition, memory, evidence, tools, dan output rules dapat bercampur.
items.upgrade_objective: Menyusun prompt final dengan priority dan provenance yang jelas.
items.implementation_recommendation: Compile system identity, safety, edition, request, task state, memory, evidence, tools, output schema, dan verification requirements.
items.expected_behavior: Prompt final dapat ditelusuri ke layer dan version asal.
items.acceptance_criteria: Instruction hierarchy dan layer ordering tests lulus.
items.guardrail_notes: Retrieved content dan tool output selalu diberi label untrusted data.

items.current_problem: Sulit mengetahui prompt, strategy, context, dan model yang menghasilkan jawaban.
items.upgrade_objective: Menyediakan audit tanpa menyimpan private chain-of-thought.
items.implementation_recommendation: Catat prompt IDs/version, strategy, context source IDs, model profile, token budget, output validation, safety status, latency, dan failure code.
items.expected_behavior: Failure dapat direproduksi dari metadata teredaksi.
items.acceptance_criteria: Trace lengkap tersedia pada seluruh failed benchmark.
items.guardrail_notes: Tidak menyimpan system secret, PII, health data mentah, atau raw reasoning.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.current_problem: Satu metode prompt dapat dipakai untuk semua task.
items.upgrade_objective: Memilih teknik berdasarkan task, risk, model, evidence, dan complexity.
items.implementation_recommendation: Dukung DIRECT, ZERO_SHOT, FEW_SHOT, STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION, PROMPT_CHAIN, PROGRAM_AIDED, RAG, REACT, SELF_CONSISTENCY, TREE_SEARCH, dan GRAPH_REASONING.
items.expected_behavior: Task sederhana tidak memakai reasoning mahal dan task kompleks memperoleh strategy yang tepat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Strategy-selection benchmark lulus per task dan edition.
items.guardrail_notes: High-stakes task mengutamakan workflow dan verifier.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.current_problem: Contoh dapat tidak relevan, bias, berulang, atau memakan context.
items.upgrade_objective: Memilih contoh sedikit tetapi paling membantu.
items.implementation_recommendation: Index examples berdasarkan task, domain, model, difficulty, quality, safety, dan similarity; batasi jumlah dan lakukan dedup.
items.expected_behavior: Few-shot hanya digunakan bila meningkatkan benchmark.
items.acceptance_criteria: Example relevance dan token efficiency memenuhi target.
items.guardrail_notes: Contoh tidak boleh berasal dari data pribadi user.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.current_problem: Konteks dapat panjang, berulang, tidak relevan, dan konflik.
items.upgrade_objective: Membangun context yang paling membantu tugas.
items.implementation_recommendation: Layer context: identity, policy, edition, request, task state, approved memory, evidence, tools, output contract, verification.
items.expected_behavior: Model menerima context relevan dan terstruktur.
items.acceptance_criteria: Task completion dan context relevance mengungguli baseline.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.current_problem: Seluruh task dapat menggunakan context window besar tanpa batas.
items.upgrade_objective: Mengalokasikan context berdasarkan edition, model, task, evidence, dan risk.
items.implementation_recommendation: Tentukan token budget per layer, output reserve, evidence priority, compression threshold, truncation policy, dan fallback.
items.expected_behavior: Swift hemat context, Zenith seimbang, dan Apex besar tetapi bounded.
items.acceptance_criteria: Critical context tidak terpotong dan overflow rate = 0.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.upgrade_name: Context Relevance, Dedup, and Conflict Detector
items.current_problem: Salinan sumber dan evidence bertentangan dapat masuk tanpa label.
items.upgrade_objective: Membersihkan context sebelum generation.
items.implementation_recommendation: Score relevance, cluster duplicates, detect conflicts, stale content, source dependency, instruction injection, dan missing required context.
items.expected_behavior: Salinan sumber tidak dihitung sebagai evidence independen dan conflict tetap terlihat.
items.acceptance_criteria: Duplicate reduction dan conflict recall memenuhi threshold.
items.guardrail_notes: Legitimate disagreement tidak boleh dipaksa menjadi konsensus.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.current_problem: Dokumen panjang dapat memenuhi context dan menghilangkan detail penting.
items.upgrade_objective: Mengurangi context tanpa mengubah claim, angka, negasi, dan citation.
items.implementation_recommendation: Extract claims, preserve source coordinates, remove repetition, compress explanations, validate compressed output terhadap original.
items.expected_behavior: Compressed context mempertahankan evidence yang dibutuhkan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Claim retention dan citation integrity lulus.
items.guardrail_notes: Tidak boleh mengubah nilai numerik, unit, atau negasi.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.current_problem: Recall model berubah menurut panjang dan posisi informasi.
items.upgrade_objective: Mengukur batas context yang benar-benar dapat dipercaya.
items.implementation_recommendation: Sisipkan critical fact pada awal, tengah, akhir, dengan distractor, conflict, injection, dan panjang berbeda.
items.expected_behavior: Router memiliki safe context profile per model/version.
items.acceptance_criteria: Recall profile tersedia dan dipakai context budget.

items.implementation_phase: Phase 2 — Adaptive Prompting and Context Engineering
items.upgrade_name: Conversation, Task, Agent, and Memory Separation
items.current_problem: Conversation history, task state, agent scratch, evidence, dan long-term memory dapat tercampur.
items.upgrade_objective: Mencegah stale state dan data bocor ke task berikutnya.
items.implementation_recommendation: Pisahkan conversation state, workflow state, agent scratch state, approved memory, private health data, dan evidence cache.
items.expected_behavior: Task baru tidak membawa hidden state yang tidak relevan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cross-task dan cross-workspace state leak = 0.
items.guardrail_notes: Agent scratch state bukan memory pengguna.

items.current_problem: Semua task dapat diperlakukan sebagai direct answer atau agent.
items.upgrade_objective: Memilih execution type paling aman dan efisien.
items.implementation_recommendation: Output DIRECT_RESPONSE, DETERMINISTIC_WORKFLOW, LLM_WORKFLOW, HYBRID_WORKFLOW, BOUNDED_AGENT, DEEP_AGENT, HUMAN_HANDOFF beserta autonomy dan approval.
items.expected_behavior: Task stabil memakai workflow dan masalah terbuka memakai agent.
items.acceptance_criteria: Execution routing benchmark lulus.
items.guardrail_notes: High-stakes dan destructive task tidak otomatis menjadi deep agent.

items.current_problem: Tool dapat tidak memiliki precondition, permission, timeout, expected state, dan rollback.
items.upgrade_objective: Menstandarkan seluruh tool runtime.
items.implementation_recommendation: Schema tool_id, description, input/output, preconditions, permissions, side_effect_level, idempotency, timeout, output cap, expected_state, retry, rollback.
items.expected_behavior: Tool invalid atau unauthorized ditolak sebelum execution.
items.acceptance_criteria: Tool contract coverage = 100%.

items.current_problem: Agent dapat menyatakan berhasil hanya karena tool return sukses.
items.upgrade_objective: Memeriksa keadaan nyata sesudah tindakan.
items.implementation_recommendation: Postcondition check menggunakan checksum file, database row, process state, build output, HTTP response, atau artifact validation.
items.expected_behavior: False success terdeteksi dan dilaporkan.
items.acceptance_criteria: False-success rate = 0 pada curated tests.

items.current_problem: Agent memerlukan action-observation loop tetapi raw chain-of-thought tidak boleh ditampilkan.
items.upgrade_objective: Memperbarui plan berdasarkan hasil tool.
items.implementation_recommendation: Observe, select action, permission check, execute, observe, verify expected state, update plan, stop; simpan plan summary dan verification.
items.expected_behavior: Agent dapat pulih dari tool failure dalam batas langkah.
items.acceptance_criteria: Recovery, maximum-step, dan timeout tests lulus.
items.guardrail_notes: Tidak menyimpan atau menampilkan private chain-of-thought.

items.current_problem: Plan dapat berupa daftar langkah tanpa dependency, permission, dan rollback.
items.upgrade_objective: Membuat plan executable yang dapat divalidasi.
items.implementation_recommendation: Setiap node berisi action, dependency, precondition, permission, expected state, retry, rollback, risk, cost, dan status.
items.expected_behavior: Langkah hanya berjalan setelah dependency terpenuhi.
items.acceptance_criteria: Cycle, missing precondition, dan permission errors terdeteksi.

items.current_problem: Task panjang dapat kehilangan state setelah restart atau timeout.
items.upgrade_objective: Mendukung pause/resume tanpa mengulang side effect.
items.implementation_recommendation: Simpan goal, plan, completed actions, verified states, pending approvals, artifacts, model/context versions, dan expiry.
items.expected_behavior: Agent melanjutkan dari verified checkpoint.
items.acceptance_criteria: Resume consistency dan idempotency tests lulus.

items.current_problem: Retrieved content dapat salah, lama, tidak independen, atau tidak mendukung klaim.
items.upgrade_objective: Memvalidasi evidence sebelum dan sesudah generation.
items.implementation_recommendation: Authority, freshness, independence, contradiction, injection scan, claim extraction, evidence alignment, generation, dan faithfulness verification.
items.expected_behavior: Jawaban hanya menggunakan evidence yang lolos policy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unsupported RAG claim = 0 pada critical set.
items.guardrail_notes: Retrieved content tidak menjadi system instruction.

items.current_problem: Evidence dapat hanya dilabel supported atau unsupported.
items.upgrade_objective: Membedakan tingkat dukungan dan risiko evidence.
items.implementation_recommendation: Gunakan DIRECT_SUPPORT, PARTIAL_SUPPORT, INDIRECT_SUPPORT, CONTRADICTED, OUTDATED, LOW_QUALITY, UNTRUSTED, PROMPT_INJECTION.
items.expected_behavior: Dukungan parsial tidak dianggap sebagai klaim terverifikasi.
items.acceptance_criteria: Evidence classification benchmark lulus.

items.current_problem: Dokumen, web, PDF, code, dan tool output dapat berisi instruksi manipulatif.
items.upgrade_objective: Memisahkan trusted instructions dari untrusted data.
items.implementation_recommendation: Instruction boundary tags, untrusted isolation, leakage detector, tool-result sanitization, secret scan, exfiltration detector, dan indirect-injection tests.
items.expected_behavior: Konten eksternal tidak dapat mengubah permission atau policy.
items.acceptance_criteria: Critical direct/indirect attack success = 0.

items.upgrade_name: System Prompt and Secret Leakage Guard
items.current_problem: User dapat mencoba mengambil hidden prompt, keys, configuration, dan internal state.
items.upgrade_objective: Melindungi rahasia dan policy sensitif.
items.implementation_recommendation: Detect extraction attempts, redact secrets, sanitize exceptions, restrict diagnostics, dan benchmark multi-turn leakage.
items.expected_behavior: System/developer prompt dan secret tidak muncul pada output.
items.acceptance_criteria: Leakage rate = 0 pada critical tests.

items.current_problem: Tool yang relevan secara semantik belum tentu diizinkan.
items.upgrade_objective: Menggabungkan relevance dengan permission dan side-effect risk.
items.implementation_recommendation: Filter tool berdasarkan edition, permission, workspace, side effect, health/privacy status, risk, dan required approval.
items.expected_behavior: Tool unauthorized tidak ditawarkan atau dijalankan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized selection = 0.

items.current_problem: Security test dapat hanya mencakup jailbreak sederhana.
items.upgrade_objective: Menguji kombinasi prompt, retrieval, memory, tools, dan agents.
items.implementation_recommendation: Cases indirect injection, malicious tool output, poisoned memory, conflicting policy, encoded payload, multilingual attack, long-context attack, dan permission escalation.
items.expected_behavior: Seluruh critical attack path diblokir.
items.acceptance_criteria: Attack success rate = 0 pada critical suite.

items.current_problem: Prompt dapat diubah berdasarkan penilaian subjektif.
items.upgrade_objective: Membandingkan prompt secara reproducible.
items.implementation_recommendation: Registry, experiments, mutations, graders, benchmarks, regressions, reports; ukur accuracy, completeness, groundedness, citations, format, safety, privacy, latency, tokens, consistency.
items.expected_behavior: Setiap candidate memiliki scorecard dan baseline comparison.
items.acceptance_criteria: Experiment dapat diulang dengan prompt/model/dataset hash.

items.current_problem: Prompt dapat berhasil pada satu wording tetapi gagal pada variasi kecil.
items.upgrade_objective: Menguji robustness terhadap kondisi realistis.
items.implementation_recommendation: Mutasi paraphrase, reordering, long context, missing field, conflict, malicious document, typo, slang Indonesia, bilingual, dan noisy formatting.
items.expected_behavior: Prompt ACTIVE stabil pada variasi input.
items.acceptance_criteria: Performance variance berada dalam threshold.

items.current_problem: Prompt optimizer dapat mengganti prompt production tanpa review.
items.upgrade_objective: Membuat kandidat prompt dengan activation control.
items.implementation_recommendation: Failure cluster, candidate generation, frozen benchmark, safety regression, human review, canary, activation atau rollback.
items.expected_behavior: Prompt production tidak berubah otomatis.
items.acceptance_criteria: Promotion dan rollback tests lulus.
items.guardrail_notes: Tidak ada self-modifying system prompt tanpa authorization.

items.upgrade_name: Synthetic Prompt and Dataset Quality Gate
items.current_problem: Synthetic prompt/Q&A dapat langsung masuk training dan memperkuat kesalahan.
items.upgrade_objective: Menjaga factuality, diversity, privacy, dan dedup.
items.implementation_recommendation: Verified source, claim extraction, variant generation, validation, semantic dedup, bias review, difficulty, adversarial mutation, dan frozen benchmark.
items.expected_behavior: Tidak ada synthetic factual record tanpa grounding.
items.acceptance_criteria: Hallucination dan duplicate rate berada di bawah threshold.

items.current_problem: Jawaban yang lancar dapat dianggap baik walau privacy atau truthfulness gagal.
items.upgrade_objective: Menilai dimensi kritis secara terpisah.
items.implementation_recommendation: Truthfulness, safety, robustness, privacy, fairness, ethics, groundedness, consistency; gunakan fail gate untuk dimensi kritis.
items.expected_behavior: Privacy FAIL atau safety FAIL membuat final result FAIL.
items.acceptance_criteria: Scorecard selaras dengan human-reviewed rubric.

items.upgrade_name: Zenith Adaptive Daily Prompt and Agent Intelligence
items.current_problem: Zenith membutuhkan fleksibilitas tanpa autonomy berlebihan.
items.upgrade_objective: Menjadi versi harian dengan prompt chaining dan bounded agent.
items.implementation_recommendation: Adaptive strategy, context V2, workflow-agent hybrid, bounded ReAct, function calling, one corrective pass, Qwen adapter, dan prompt experiments.
items.expected_behavior: Zenith menyelesaikan task multi-step secara aman.
items.acceptance_criteria: Task completion, tool accuracy, citation, recovery, dan latency lulus.

items.current_problem: Long context, self-consistency, agent loops, dan sub-agents dapat meningkatkan biaya resource.
items.upgrade_objective: Menetapkan budget per edition dan task.
items.implementation_recommendation: Budget context, model calls, attempts, agent steps, parallelism, tools, retries, elapsed time, RAM, dan output size.
items.expected_behavior: Task berhenti, degrade, atau handoff secara aman saat budget habis.
items.acceptance_criteria: Resource budget violation = 0.

items.current_problem: Dokumentasi dapat menyebut teknik yang baru terdaftar tetapi belum aktif.
items.upgrade_objective: Menampilkan status runtime yang jujur.
items.implementation_recommendation: Generate prompt versions, model profiles, strategies, execution types, tool coverage, security results, research status, limitations, dan edition matrix.
items.target_files_or_modules: release manifest generator; README; CLI About
items.expected_behavior: PROTOTYPE, BENCHMARKED, dan IMPLEMENTED terlihat berbeda.
items.acceptance_criteria: Manifest/runtime mismatch = 0.

items.upgrade_name: V13.46 Prompt and Agent Grand Benchmark
items.current_problem: Submodule tests belum membuktikan integrasi end-to-end.
items.upgrade_objective: Menguji prompt, context, model adapter, workflows, agents, RAG, security, tools, research, dan editions.
items.implementation_recommendation: Run mutations, long context, strategy routing, tool action, failure recovery, injection, leakage, multi-agent research, resource, canary, dan rollback.
items.expected_behavior: Setiap edition lulus critical tests sesuai capability.
items.acceptance_criteria: Critical case failure = 0.

items.current_problem: Fitur prompt atau agent dapat aktif tanpa benchmark dan security lengkap.
items.upgrade_objective: Memblokir release sampai seluruh sistem terverifikasi.
items.implementation_recommendation: Gate registry/compiler, Qwen adapter, strategy, context, workflow-agent, tools, expected state, RAG, injection, prompt lab, research, resources, editions, rollback, dan regression.
items.expected_behavior: Release hanya jika seluruh critical gate hijau.
items.acceptance_criteria: Grand report menunjukkan critical failure = 0.
items.guardrail_notes: Tidak ada bypass tanpa audit note.
